round_8_final.true_root_cause: v_axi4s_vid_out slave-mode timing control signal vtg_ce LEFT FLOATING when v_tc_0 was replaced by lcd_panel_adapter module_ref. vid_out pauses external timing via vtg_ce during SOF alignment + FIFO prefill, releases it to set locked=1 and start DE. Original v_tc_0 received this via gen_clken; adapter never wired it -> hcnt/vcnt free-run -> locked forever 0 -> DE never asserts -> white screen. External tool proved by Xilinx vid_out source simulation: correct SOF/EOL stream + free-running timing = never locks; vtg_ce-gated = locks. Confirmed on board: image displays.
